thread:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Pager fired: elevated 5xx + timeouts observed at gateway (us-east-1). Automated runbook executed. Incident ID INC-2026-33321. Paging @maya :rotating_light:

maya: I'm oncall, joining now. Seeing 502/504 spike starting ~3332109600 (~6m ago). Error rate ~3.5% on ingress-rt-gateway. Customer impact: short tail of failed requests to hosted API.

jon: can someone drop a few correlation IDs / sample traces? I want head traces where gateway reports upstream 5xx. Also is there any deploy or infra change?

rachel: runtime team — no scheduled deploys in the last hour from runtime side. Last runtime rollout finished ~20m ago but that was a separate batch. I'll check logs.

sam: infra side — no infra deploys. Autoscaler did scale up some dedicated pools at 3332108700. Uploading filtered log bundle (kvlogs + traces): https://logs.redwood/incident/33321/kvlogs.zip

maya: quick samples (corrIDs): c4f2a1b2-8f, b9a18d22-03, 7ef3c9e0-41. Gateway shows: `upstream_response_time=3200ms status=502 upstream=10.4.5.23:8080`

jon: hypothesis A: upstream model-backend returning `503`/`RST_STREAM` for long requests -> gateway surfaces 502. Hypothesis B: gateway retry amplification — retries piling on upstream causing timeouts (queueing).

rachel: pulled runtime trace for corrID c4f2a1b2-8f: backend returned `503` after a 3.1s CPU stall. Log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T14:08:23Z pid=4201 req=c4f2a1b2 status=503 duration_ms=3120 backend=mbp-03 model=llama-13b quantized=false
2026-03-17T14:08:23Z pid=4201 stack=worker-13 wait=2800ms exec=320ms
```

sam: infra metrics: connection pool on mbp-03 hit 95% used, SYN backlog spiked. Also increased retransmits on that host. Putting host under maintenance to drain.

maya: mitigation plan: 1) drain mbp-03, 2) enable lightweight fallback model variant for affected route, 3) temporarily reduce gateway retries from 2->0 for the route. Who can run?

sam: I can drain host now: `infractl drain-host --name=mbp-03 --grace=30s`

rachel: I'll trigger the fallback route: `runtimectl set-route --route=/v1/generate --model=llama-7b-fallback --timeout=6s`

jon: I'll patch gateway retries: `gatewayctl update-policy --route=/v1/generate --retries=0 --reason="mitigation 33321"`

incident-bot: Automated action: gateway policy update applied by jon at 3332109958.

maya: drain started. Observability: 5xx dropped to ~1.1% after 90s. Latency median stable.

sam: mbp-03 fully drained and removed from rotation. Uploading new trace bundle w/ correlation index: https://logs.redwood/incident/33321/trace_index.json

jon: can we capture a timeline for RCA? I'll assemble: deploys (none), autoscale event, upstream host resource exhaustion, retry amplification -> mitigation (drain + retries off + fallback).

rachel: confirmed long-request pattern on mbp-03 for requests taking >3s, likely caused by a slow upstream disk or GC pause. We'll run health-checks on that host and check process-level metrics.

maya: customer impact note: incident lasted ~7m from first pager to mitigation, peak errors ~3.5%, ~1.2k failed req/min at peak. Top affected customers: acct-142, acct-991 (billing notified).

sam: added a short runbook action item: add connection pool headroom alert and reduce retry default in gateway config for this route.

rachel: runtime will open a follow-up to analyze backend slow-path and apply fix/patch if it's GC/IO related.

maya: thanks all — handing to postmortem channel for RCA drafting. Will share timeline and log links in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-33321 mitigated by runbook actions; incident remains open for RCA until postmortem complete."
